descriptions.w3d_cc29b_scale_text_8018bb28: For both original unit scale values, finds and removes an existing scale component by class/index. Otherwise allocates a scale component, stores each axis and marks its native dirty flag after each store, then adds it to the component set. Observed56-byte frame and stack8 index output are preserved;20- and24-byte workspace models both fit, so the original local declaration/sizeof is unknown.
